title: Cushman & Wakefield Hires Michael Schirick as Tri-State Market Lead for its Valuation & Advisory Business
summary: Michael Schirick has joined Cushman & Wakefield as the Tri-State Market Lead for Valuation & Advisory (V&A).
body_markdown:
Michael Schirick


**[NEW YORK](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/offices/new-york) – September 21, 2026** – Cushman & Wakefield, a global real estate services firm, announced that[Michael Schirick](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/people/michael-schirick) has joined the organization as the Tri-State Market Lead for[Valuation & Advisory (V&A)](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/services/valuation-and-advisory) . In this role, Mr. Schirick will oversee the firm’s valuation business across New York, New Jersey and Connecticut, working closely with the national V&A leadership team to advance the firm’s client strategy throughout the Tri-State market.


“Michael brings an exceptional combination of industry expertise, strategic perspective and firsthand understanding of what clients need from their valuation partners,” said[Eric Lewis](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states) , Executive Managing Director of Strategic Accounts and Client Development, V&A Americas at Cushman & Wakefield. “His experience and client-centric approach make him an outstanding addition to our leadership team, and we look forward to the continued growth of our Tri-State Valuation & Advisory business under his leadership.”


Mr. Schirick brings extensive commercial real estate valuation and leadership experience to Cushman & Wakefield, with a unique perspective developed across both the client and service-provider sides of the industry. Most recently, he led Morgan Stanley’s global commercial real estate valuation platform, where he worked closely with valuation teams across the industry and developed a deep understanding of the evolving needs of institutional clients.


Mr. Schirick succeeds[Rob Nardella](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/united-states/people/rob-nardella) , who is transitioning from the Tri-State Market Lead position after 17 years in the role. Mr. Nardella will remain with the firm as Client & Strategy Advisor to Tri-State Market Leadership, supporting client relationships and ensuring continuity through the leadership transition.


“I’m excited to join Cushman & Wakefield and lead a talented team with a strong reputation across the Tri-State market,” added Mr. Schirick. “I look forward to building on the team’s success, deepening our relationships with clients and identifying new opportunities to grow the business.”
